thread:
alex: Getting alerts: hosted inference returning 500s for several customers in eu-west. Lots of upstream worker restarts.
maria: :eyes: which pool / model? any patterns on payload size or context length?
sre_jordan: Logs show repeated container restarts with SIGSEGV and CUDA OOM around the same time.
alex: Affected model: rwd-open-13b-q4f24 (quantized). Spike started ~3687654300 and correlates with a high-QPS job from a single customer.
support_raj: Customer reported timeouts -> 500s, then fallback to lower tier worked. They sent a sample request (pasted below).
support_raj: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"rwd-open-13b-q4f24","input":"<~6k tokens of context>","max_tokens":512}'``` 
eng_infra_kate: Can confirm container logs include an LLVM abort and then kernel message: "out of memory: kill process 4321 (infer-runner) total-vm:..." followed by coredump.
alex: Stack traces look like a fault in attn kernel during KV-prefetch. Snippet:
alex: ```
[2026-06-12T09:45:12Z] infer-runner[4321]: segfault at 0 ip 00007f87a1c3e9c0 sp 00007ffe1a2b3c10 error 4 in libattn.so[7f87a1b00000+1f0000]
[2026-06-12T09:45:12Z] kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 4321 (infer-runner) total-vm:1234567kB, anon-rss:987654kB, file-rss:12345kB
```
maria: Does this only hit quantized variants? any recent runtime / kernel package rollouts?
eng_infra_kate: We rolled a small runtime tweak yesterday to optimize KV layout for q4f24; config change listed in deploy logs: `runtime: attn_prefetch=enabled`.
sre_jordan: Hypothesis: combination of large context + prefetch on quantized path uses more GPU memory than estimated -> OOM -> bad pointer in attn kernel when partial allocation fails -> segfault.
alex: Immediate mitigation options?
eng_infra_kate: 1) Disable attn_prefetch per-model until we patch. 2) Route traffic to non-prefetch variant (rwd-open-13b-q4f24-noprefetch). 3) Scale up worker pool (short term).
support_raj: Customer asks for ETA. Can we do a soft-fallback automatically for requests > 2k tokens?
maria: We can implement a routing rule: requests with input_tokens > 2048 route to noprefetch or CPU fallback. Need FastConfig change.
eng_infra_kate: I can push an emergency config: flip attn_prefetch=false for that model in hosted catalog. Will take ~3m to propagate to active routers.
oncall-bot: Deploy started by eng_infra_kate at 3687654332. Job ID: deploy-8721. :rocket:
alex: Meanwhile capture artifacts for root cause: gcore of crashed pid, /var/log/nvidia/driver.log, output of `nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY,UTILIZATION`, container stdout/stderr, and the coredump backtrace.
sre_jordan: Also need reproducer: a short script to replay the customer's payload in a loop to reproduce on staging with same quantized runtime and prefetch enabled.
sre_jordan: Repro steps posted below.
sre_jordan: ```bash
# reproduce loop (staging)
for i in $(seq 1 10); do
  curl -sS -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $STAGING_KEY" \
    -d '{"model":"rwd-open-13b-q4f24","input":"'"$LARGE_CONTEXT"'","max_tokens":512}' &
done
wait
```
alex: After routing change, customer reported immediate reduction in 500s and most traffic succeeded.
support_raj: Customer update: they accept temporary fallback. Asking for root cause timeline and patch ETA.
maria: Next steps: eng_infra to revert prefetch flag, eng-ml to add bounds check in attn kernel, runtime to add graceful OOM handling (fail-safe to return 429 rather than segfault).
eng_infra_kate: Rolling back prefetch flag now. Will also start a canary deploy of a small alloc-safety patch to attn runtime in staging.
oncall-bot: Rollback deployed at 3687654350. Canary: 5% staging, 0% prod. Monitor CPU/GPU mem for 10 min.
sre_jordan: Collecting all artifacts into incident bucket: s3://redwood-incident/3687654321/ (gcore, logs, nvlogs, coredump, customer payload). If anyone needs access ping me.
alex: Thanks team. I'll draft an incident summary for postmortem once we have kernel patch and can confirm repro and fix.
maria: +1. Suggested followups: add request-size routing rule, add OOM metric alerts on per-model GPU mem, and run load test for quantized prefetch path.
support_raj: I notified CS and set expectation: short fallback, fix ETA 3-5 business days. Will update customer after eng estimates.
eng_infra_kate: Can someone from eng-ml own the kernel patch? @sre_jordan can coordinate test vectors.
sre_jordan: I can coordinate test harness with eng-ml. Assigning owner: @maria for kernel change tracking.
alex: Closing thread for now; reopen if we see reoccurrence. :white_check_mark:"
